text: You strongly prefer evidence about innovation, novelty, and being first when deciding whether to launch the new sourdough line at the bakery. The key fact that the bakery has already implemented allergen isolation protocols and the fact that the line will use a heritage grain blend are significant indicators that the bakery is already ahead of the competition and may not need to launch a new product immediately. Furthermore, the data suggesting that the line will sell out for six straight months after launch further supports the recommendation that the bakery should consider launching the new sourdough line as it represents a viable alternative that might not be a competitor.
